warnings: Ground beams (คานคอดิน) of the combined footing/ground-beam plan; footings and columns are in _view1_footing_plan.json.

G1 runs along row A (split at the C1 on A2) and along the edge line B''; G2 on lines 1 and 3 between A and B, G3 on line 2; G4 along row B. G2/1 (lines 1 and 3) and G3/1 (line 2) are 1.20 cantilevers from row B out to the edge line B'' — S-03's elevations dimension them 1.20 from the column, and G2/1 / G3/1 carry their own heavier top steel.

The edge beam G1 on B'' has no columns — both segments bear on the cantilever tips G2/1 / G3/1 (flagged bears_on_beam). S-01's 1.20 tick lands on its outer face; the beam is recorded on the tick line B''.
There is no edge beam on the A side: the 0.60 band above row A is the S0 walkway slab only.

Slabs: the four panels inside the beam grid (A-B and B-B'', bays 1-2 and 2-3) carry the precast-plank symbol (horizontal double arrow, no mark) with '⊕+X.XX' finish (ให้ดูแบบแปลนพื้น) and '[⊕+0.32]' structure-with-topping level. The band outside the beams carries 'S0' at '⊕+0.20' (4 tags). The tag reads S-zero: its second glyph matches the digit 0 of '+0.20' printed beside it, not a round letter O (cf. section 10's SI / S1 warning).

Legend on the sheet: 'พื้นสำเร็จรูปชนิดแผ่นตัน มอก. 828-2546 รับ น.น บรรทุกปลอดภัย 300 กก/ตร.ม คอนกรีตทับหน้าหนา 5 ซม. ตะแกรงเหล็กสำเร็จรูป Ø4มม.@ 0.20ม.หรือเหล็กตะแกรง Ø6 มม.@ 0.25 ม. #' — kept on the precast-slab element.
